assertion.text: The Lean 4 theorem `erdos_1150.variants.parseval_lower_bound` is proven and kernel-verified (axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; no sorryAx): for every polynomial P over ℂ of degree n whose coefficients (indices 0..n) all lie in {-1, 1}, the supremum of |P(z)| over the unit circle |z| = 1 is at least √(n+1). This closes a previously-open `sorry` (category: textbook) attached to Erdős Problem 1150 in google-deepmind/formal-conjectures.
